integrity: Original source map and prior results credited; finite checker does not prove infinite-dimensional or invariant measure claims. Literature-priority comparison is not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Full inverse-fiber count on the unrestricted-belief extension does not equal an all-output physical inverse census; the source CVaR-saturated variant is excluded. Claims neither chaos/no-chaos nor global attraction. Endpoint k=1 excluded. Compact support away from x=0,1 is needed for metric consequences. Local fold normal forms are classical.
scientific_scope: Smooth interior phase of a two-dimensional risk-sensitive multiplicative-weights map; extended real-belief inverse census; physical three-preimage existence; compact fully invariant interior sets and compactly supported invariant laws on a constant-Jacobian ridge.
title: Sharp inverse-branch bifurcation and constant-Jacobian ridge in risk-sensitive learning dynamics
